name: octocode-mcp
description: Code research MCP server for GitHub, npm, local files, and LSP semantics
long_description: MCP server with code research tools across GitHub, npm, local files, and LSP semantics. Agents orient, search, read exact evidence, and prove findings with typed continuations and sanitized output.

tools.name: clasify
tools.description: Classify supplied state or locate answers in unread resources without returning bodies (conditional: requires OCTOCODE_CLASSIFICATION_API)

tools.name: ghSearchRepo
tools.description: Discover GitHub repositories by keywords, owner, or filters

tools.name: ghSearchCode
tools.description: Find indexed code or file paths in a GitHub owner or repo

tools.name: ghStructure
tools.description: Browse a known GitHub repository's directory tree

tools.name: ghGetFileContent
tools.description: Read a known GitHub file or exact source region

tools.name: ghSearchHistory
tools.description: Find GitHub pull requests, issues, or commits

tools.name: ghGetHistoryItem
tools.description: Read a known pull request, issue, commit, or comparison

tools.name: artifactSearch
tools.description: Find packages, dependency metadata, or upstream source

tools.name: localSearch
tools.description: Find literal or regex matches in local files

tools.name: structureSearch
tools.description: Outline local directories or find files by name or metadata

tools.name: astSearch
tools.description: Find declarations, syntax trees, or structural code matches

tools.name: astTopology
tools.description: Analyze local dependency and reachability topology (beta: requires OCTOCODE_BETA)

tools.name: localFetch
tools.description: Read a known local file or exact source region

tools.name: lspSearch
tools.description: Resolve symbols, references, calls, types, or diagnostics

github_token.title: GitHub Token
github_token.description: Personal access token for GitHub API (optional, increases rate limits)
